items.title: 68191_William (Bill) H. Challis Oral History Interview
items.q: The interviewee mentions Barris as part of the group Paul Whiteman brought in ('he's got Matty Malneck was there... Paul picked them up and I guess they were a bust until he brought [Harry] Barris in'), but does not describe a direct personal interaction or professional relationship with Barris hims

ctx.x: You would have to go around, hang around and wait to find out through different ways what should be done here. But yet they wanted you around. They wanted you to be around for any kind of recording that had to be done, and that used to irk me a little bit, because you feel as if you're not doing anything, not contributing.

So anyway, we were playing at the Pier down there -- this was the -- was it the Steel or the Million Dollar Pier, that's often confused, said Steel Pier, but I think it's the Million Dollar Pier. The band is doing very well, as far as that's concerned, but no tremendous crowds down there. So one night we're around there and who walks in but Jimmy. Now, Jimmy had made several of our recording dates and all the guys knew him anyway and liked him, but he comes in this one night and he's bringing Paul Whiteman, and…
had quite a bit and he had talked them all into driving down. I guess he had talked Paul into driving them down --
